Normal.diet_recommendation: Maintain a balanced diet with iron-rich foods.
Normal.referral_action: No referral needed. Annual routine checkup recommended.

Mild.referral_action: Follow up with a general practitioner within 4 weeks.

Moderate.diet_recommendation: Structured iron-rich diet with Vitamin C to enhance absorption.
Moderate.referral_action: Consult a physician within 1–2 weeks. Iron supplement may be required.

Severe.diet_recommendation: Immediate medical attention required. Oral or IV iron therapy likely needed.
Severe.referral_action: URGENT: Refer to hematologist or emergency care immediately.
